subject: general
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following mathematical statement?

(18)/(60)times (15)/(108)times?=19
solution:
**Calculation:**

(18)/(60)times (15)/(108)times?=19

⇒ ? = 19times 6 times 4

⇒ ? = 456

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
